output.question: Which identification strategy? choice ∈ recursive|long_run|sign|changes_in_volatility|independence|non_gaussian|local_projection (a theoretical choice, not a data test)

output.rationale: A clear contemporaneous ordering -> Cholesky/recursive. ⚠ the ordering IS an assumption (test its robustness).
Long-run restriction (e.g. a demand shock neutral on output) -> Blanchard-Quah (LRIM).
A-priori signs of the responses (not zero restrictions) -> sign restrictions (Uhlig reject/penalty, RWZ).
A known regime or break in volatility -> changes-in-volatility statistical ID.
Statistical independence of the shocks -> distance covariance ID (seed).
Non-Gaussian shocks -> non-Gaussian ML ID (seed).
VAR misspecification concern / external instrument -> Local Projections (lp_linear, lp_linear_iv with an external IV).

output.question: What are you modelling? choice ∈ univariate_garch|dcc|ms_mean|ms_garch|threshold. (The GARCH family REQUIRES run_arch_test first.)

output.rationale: Conditional variance of a single series (volatility clustering) -> univariate GARCH (ga_spec->ga_fit->ga_forecast). REQUIRES ARCH effects.
Several series with time-varying correlations (contagion) -> DCC-GARCH.
Abrupt changes in the mean or dynamics (business-cycle regimes) -> Markov-switching mean/AR. Does NOT require ARCH.
Regime-switching in the variance as well -> MS-GARCH (msg_fit_ml/msg_fit_mcmc, MCMC->seed).
Nonlinear threshold dynamics -> setar_test (linearity) COMES FIRST; then setar_fit (abrupt) or lstar_fit (smooth). Does NOT require ARCH.

output.question: Where does the exogeneity come from? choice ∈ rdd|staggered_did|synthetic_control|iv|dml|causal_forest|ts_intervention|granger. ⚠ Granger = predictive, NOT causal.

output.rationale: Sharp or fuzzy cutoff in a running variable -> RDD (rd_robust/rd_bandwidth_select).
Treatment at different times (staggered) -> Callaway-Sant'Anna group-time ATT (did_att_gt->did_aggregate_att); corrects TWFE bias.
One treated unit plus a donor pool -> Synthetic Control (sc_prepare_data->sc_fit; inference scp_intervals).
A valid instrument (relevant + exclusion) -> IV/2SLS (iv_2sls or fx_fit(...|iv)).
High-dim controls, √n-consistent effect -> Double/Debiased ML (dml_plr/_irm).
Heterogeneous treatment (CATE) -> causal forest (causal_forest_fit->causal_forest_ate).
Time-series intervention at a known date (single-series counterfactual) -> CausalImpact (BSTS).
Predictive precedence (NOT structural) -> Granger causality (vr_causality).

output.rationale: Growth-at-Risk: STEP 1 qr_growth_at_risk (conditional quantiles); STEP 2 (the full ABG) st_fit_quantiles->st_density/st_shortfall (skew-t density + ES).
Portfolio/returns tail risk -> risk_var/risk_expected_shortfall (historical/gaussian/modified Cornish-Fisher).

output.question: Which decomposition? choice ∈ hp (two-sided in-sample) | one_sided_hp (real-time/policy) | hamilton (regression, no HP artefacts) | band_pass | uc_kalman (model-based, with CI) | dfa (multivariate common trend)

output.rationale: Two-sided smoothing, ex post -> HP filter (lambda=1600 for quarterly data). ⚠ end-point bias + spurious cycles.
Real-time/one-sided (policy; Basel credit gap lambda=400000) -> one-sided HP.
Avoiding HP spurious-cycle artefacts -> Hamilton regression filter.
Band-pass cycle -> filt_baxter_king (Baxter-King) / filt_christiano_fitzgerald (Christiano-Fitzgerald).
Model-based unobserved components (trend/cycle as state, with CI) -> kf_trend_cycle / dl_trend_cycle.
Multivariate common trend (NAIRU-style, many indicators -> one trend) -> dynamic factor analysis (mss_dfa).

output.question: Which panel step? choice ∈ poolability | fe_re | dynamic | panel_unit_root | csd

output.rationale: Are there individual effects? -> pd_poolability_test (Breusch-Pagan LM) + pd_effects_ftest (F, within vs pooling).
FE vs RE (are the effects correlated with the regressors?) -> pd_hausman_test (reject ⇒ FE); estimate with pd_fit(model='within'|'random').
Dynamic panel (lagged y), small T and large N (Nickell bias) -> GMM (pd_gmm_fit, NOT FE). POST-GATES: pd_gmm_autocorr_test (AR(2)) + pd_gmm_sargan_test.
Panel unit roots — ONLY for macro panels (large T) -> run_panel_unit_root (LLC/IPS/Fisher/Hadri). ⚠ hadri has the opposite polarity.
Cross-sectional dependence (common shocks) -> run_cipstest (Pesaran CIPS/CMG, second generation). First-generation purtest is size-distorted under CSD.

output.question: Which evaluation? choice ∈ diagnostics | backtest | compare_two | compare_many | combine | density

output.rationale: In-sample diagnostics (model adequacy) -> run_bg_test (serial correlation) / run_bp_test (heteroskedasticity) / run_reset_test (functional form); plus run_arch_test (ARCH -> volatility model).
Out-of-sample backtest (rolling origin) -> eval_rolling_origin (per-horizon RMSE/MAE).
Point-forecast comparison of two models -> Diebold-Mariano (eval_dm_test). NOT for distributions.
MANY models -> Model Confidence Set (run_mcs_procedure): the set that is not eliminated. Avoid multiple pairwise DM tests.
Combination rather than selection -> forecastHybrid (run_hybrid; equal/insample/CV weights).
Density forecast (draws) -> proper scoring: sr_crps_sample/sr_logs_sample (NEGATIVELY ORIENTED, LOWER IS BETTER) + sr_pit_sample (calibration). NOT DM.
